name: Signature
wearing: a layered, ethereal outfit of sheer, frosted {{PRIMARY}} fabric over a matte underlayer, with delicate {{ACCENT_SOFT}} glowing fibre-optic threads woven throughout, secured at the shoulders, nothing covering her head; a thin bikini-style top and a short, skimpy, intricate bottom with a few short fringes hanging down, the whole outfit translucent so the shape beneath is softly visible
pose: She stands with weight shifted, one arm bent at the elbow, her hand cupped with a ball of crackling {{ACCENT_SOFT}} lightning fusing in her palm as she casts; her other hand rests on an ornate staff planted at her side. holding: an ornate staff, upright, touching the ground, a {{ACCENT_SOFT}} lightning glow around the jewel at its top
effects: Soft gradient lightning strikes flicker in the air around her, diffused studio light catching the fibre-optic threads woven through her outfit.

notes: Deliberate 'from scratch' authoring test: only heroArt + a handful of reusable pieces are referenced (silver-gem-set.json and glowing-strap-heels.json for jewelry/footwear, a brand-new backgrounds/castle/ancient-stone-hall.json) -- wearing, pose (motion+gaze+expression combined), holding, and effects are typed directly as literal top-level fields instead of referencing decomposed component files, proving the alternate single-file authoring path works end-to-end alongside the decomposed-pieces path.
